objective: Qualify a bounded continuous public microstructure evidence journal with real gap, duplicate, restart, integrity, and distributional semantics without authentication or financial effects.
required_evidence: Provider messages are appended to a crash-resumable JSONL journal before aggregation, with receive timestamp, canonical message hash, channel, provider timestamp, and sequence number.
Duplicate identities are ignored idempotently; conflicting duplicate identities fail closed.
Sequence numbers are evaluated independently per channel; gaps and out-of-order messages are preserved, never hidden.
A level2 snapshot must precede applied updates; updates deterministically maintain price levels and reject malformed or negative sizes.
Finalization produces deterministic gzip bytes, raw stream SHA-256, summary manifest, distributional spread/depth-walk proxies, and a rebuildable market-data index entry.
Restart and corruption tests pass before the public capture.
pass_gate: At least one level2 snapshot, one subsequent level2 update, one heartbeat, and one market-trades message are captured; no conflicting duplicate occurs; gap/out-of-order counts are explicit; replay reproduces the same final book and summary hash; bundle integrity, restart, stale/idle handling, size bounds, and repository validation pass.
failure_gate: Authentication is requested, user/account/order data is accessed, any financial effect occurs, a channel is missing, updates precede snapshot, sequence or duplicate state is ambiguous, byte/message bounds are exceeded without safe finalization, restart loses accepted messages, replay diverges, or corruption is not detected.
scope_limit: This experiment may estimate public spread/depth distributions only. It cannot qualify account fee tier, order latency, rejection probability, partial-fill probability, actual fills, strategy edge, capital eligibility, or live readiness.
